verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents data products, webhooks for general event notifications, and test banks. Nothing in it covers institution status endpoints, outage or degradation signals, or error codes that separate institution-side failures from integrator errors. Generic webhooks are an adjacent feature and earn no credit for per-institution health visibility.

support.subject: As an ops lead, per-institution health is visible — documented institution statuses, outage or degradation signals, and error codes that distinguish a bank problem from my problem
